correctness.rationale: Exact factorial splitting for ternary-separated indices; Kummer carries of (3^t+1)/2 give valuations t; B(3^R)=2 mod9 makes each block factor primitive modulo all powers of three; infinite repeated-subsequence powers cover all valuation shells; C_{N-1}=B(N)/(2(2N-1)) transfers all residues when 3^k divides N. The checker verifies finite instances but the infinite theorem is proved analytically.
